Context: 29. Postaf Tariff and Savi:ngs Schemes

| Post Office Savings Account | 4.0 % per annum on individual/ joint accounts | Minimum INR ~ 500 for opening. | Interest earned is tax free up to ~ 10,000 per year. |
| 5-Year Post Office Recurring Deposit Account (RD) | 6.5 % per annum (quarterly compounded) | Minimum INR ~ 100 per month or any amount in multiples of INR ~ 10. No maximum limit. | |
